blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Senate inquiry into accidents and public safety hazards caused by dangling and poorly maintained electrical and utility wires is being sought following several reported incidents involving motorists, pedestrians, and children. Senate Resolution No. 776, filed by Sen. Raffy Tulfo on Wednesday, seeks to direct the Senate Committee on Public Services to conduct an inquiry in aid of legislation into accidents, electrocutions, and other hazards caused by low-hanging, improperly installed, and poorly maintained electrical and overhead utility lines, cables, and poles.
